unit.why: A short anecdote: during an earthquake the Besht calms the frightened townspeople with a prediction that comes true, followed by a brief kabbalistic gloss on the letter permutation רעש/ערש.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי בשם הבעש״ט זלה"ה שפ"א היה רעש
stories.end_quote: והענין עמוק מאד מאד (ס׳ א"ה ברמזי וירא)
stories.summary_en: When a great earthquake terrified a town, the Besht reassured the people that it meant the lord would order a bed taken for his needs; this came true, and the author explains that a true sage can permute רעש (quake) into ערש (bed).

quotes: ויחרדו העם אשר במחנה מן הרעש

quotes: כי הרעש הוא שהאדון יצוה ליקח ערש לחפציו
tags.why: the Besht predicts the outcome and it comes true
the whole anecdote is a prediction that is fulfilled

quotes: ואמר להם אל ירע זאת בעיניכם
tags.why: the Besht knows the hidden meaning of the quake

quotes: כח ביד המשכיל וחכם אמתי להפוך צירוף רע״ש לצירוף ער"ש
tags.why: the sage averts a disaster by permuting its letters
